title: alchemilla alpina proles grossidens
intro: Alchemilla alpina proles grossidens, commonly known as mountain lady's mantle, is a type of flowering plant in the Rosaceae family. This perennial plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Alchemilla alpina proles grossidens include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthraquinones, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as astringency and anti-inflammatory effects.
